title: 第十三章姜露
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一股肃杀之气穿过窗户透进屋内，伴随着卷卷狂风，吹得窗户连连作响。

他提着手里的郑雅向外走去，是时候会会这个一直在幕后的家伙了。

他几步走出屋门，就看到大片人群将自己围了起来。

执法堂，还有姜家的人……

他瞬间就明白了自己现在的处境。

他“啧”了一声，自己这是被当成鱼钓了。

他瞅了眼手中的鱼饵，讥讽说道：“你家主子这么狠心，连你这种死心塌地的狗都不要了。”

“真是不知道这么形容。”

“冷血或者算计。”他摸了摸下下巴，依旧一副吊儿郎当的模样。

他忽然出现了一个想法：“要不你跟着我吧，我保证让你天天下不来床。”

但最后他还是叹了口气：“算了，我嫌你脏。”

他手指猛然发力，不顾在场众人，瞬间捏断了郑雅的脖颈。

郑雅本来就喘不上气了，再加上着突然的发力，脖子直接断开，脑袋无力地垂下，挂在半空。

【击杀练气中期人类】

【价值评估中…】

【价值：100道行值】

张守安将郑雅的尸体往远处一扔，对着远处的女子说道：“姜师姐，我的表现符合你的设想吗？”

一位女子从后方的人群中走出，她看也没看地上的尸体，只是冷声开口道：

“张守安残害同门，丧尽天良，按律就地格杀！”

“执法堂，上！”

她吩咐玩命令，四周便有不少人跃跃欲试。

一个前几日还是练气初期的修士，刚刚还恰好与练气中期的修士经过血战，现在相比已经伤痕累累。

自己只要一动手，这功绩不就来了吗，简直就是天上掉馅饼的好事。

确实，他们有这种猜想是正常的，哪有正常人能两三天就冲练气初期升级到练气大成。

更何况，他们还没见过屋内那属于练气圆满妖物的脑袋。

张守安还算可以原谅，只要他们每个人用脖子接自己一剑，张守安就算原谅他们了。

他活动了一下手上的骨头，而后用弯曲手臂，让长剑从中穿过，用之间的衣服擦了擦剑身上的雨水。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A chilling air penetrated into the house through the windows, accompanied by strong winds that made the windows rattle.

He walked out with Zheng Ya in his hand. It was time to meet this guy who had been behind the scenes.

He took a few steps out of the house and saw a large crowd surrounding him.

The Law Enforcement Hall, and the Jiang family...

He instantly understood his current situation.

He said "tsk", he was being caught as a fish.

He glanced at the bait in his hand and said sarcastically: "Your master is so cruel that he won't even let a dog like you die."

"I really don't know how to describe it."

"Cold-blooded or calculating." He touched his chin, still looking carefree.

An idea suddenly occurred to him: "How about you follow me? I promise that you won't come to bed every day."

But in the end he sighed: "Forget it, I think you are dirty."

His fingers suddenly exerted force, ignoring everyone present, and instantly broke Zheng Ya's neck.

Zheng Ya was already out of breath, and with the sudden exertion of force, her neck was severed, and her head hung weakly in the air.

[Kill a human in the middle stage of Qi training]

【Under evaluation...】

[Value: 100 Daoxing Value]

Zhang Shou'an threw Zheng Ya's body far away and said to the woman in the distance: "Senior Sister Jiang, does my performance meet your expectations?"

A woman walked out of the crowd at the back. She didn't even look at the body on the ground, she just said in a cold voice:

"Zhang Shou'an harmed his fellow disciples and showed no conscience. He will be killed on the spot according to the law!"

"Law enforcement hall, come on!"

She gave the order to Wan, and there were many people around who were eager to give it a try.

A monk who was in the early stage of Qi training just a few days ago had a bloody battle with a monk who was in the middle stage of Qi training. Now he is scarred.

As long as he takes action, won't this achievement come? It is simply a good thing that falls from the sky.

Indeed, it is normal for them to have this suspicion. How can any normal person upgrade from the initial stage of Qi training to the master of Qi training in two or three days?

What's more, they haven't seen the head of the perfect monster in the house.

Zhang Shou'an can still forgive them. As long as each of them takes his own sword with his neck, Zhang Shou'an will forgive them.

He moved the bones in his hand, then bent his arm to let the long sword pass through it, and wiped the rainwater on the sword with the clothes between him.
